description_en: Modifies the video resources of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live modify-caster-video-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --resource-id 05ab713c-676e-49c0-96ce-cc408da10000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCasterVideoResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId returned in the response.

If you create a production studio in the console, find the ID on the Cloud Production Studio page. To go to this page, choose LIVE Console > Production Studio.

The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html接口创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. If you add a video source to the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html operation, use the ResourceId returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848020.html接口添加导播台视频源，请查看AddCasterVideoResource接口调用返回的参数ResourceId值
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the video source
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the live stream.

<notice>

This parameter is required only if the video source is a live stream.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
直播流地址。

<notice>当视频源类型为直播流时，本参数才可用且必传。
</notice>
parameters.name: live_stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the video on demand (VOD) file.

<notice>

This parameter is available only if the video source is a video file that has not been imported to the material library.

</notice>

VOD files must be in MP4, FLV, or TS format
parameters.help_zh:
点播文件地址。
<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频且视频文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。
</notice>
点播文件仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式
parameters.name: vod_url

parameters.help_en:
The start offset of the video file. Unit: milliseconds.

<notice>

This parameter is valid only if the video source is a video file.

</notice>

A value greater than 0 specifies the start time to read the file. The time is an offset from the first frame
parameters.help_zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。单位：毫秒。

<notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
</notice>

大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置
parameters.name: begin_offset

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is valid only for video files. Unit: milliseconds.

If the value is greater than 0, it specifies the end time to read the file. The time is an offset from the first frame.

If the value is less than 0, it specifies the end time to read the file. The time is an offset from the last frame
parameters.help_zh:
仅对文件视频有效。单位：毫秒。 
         
大于0时，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
小于0时，表示相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置
parameters.name: end_offset

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is valid only for video files. It specifies the number of times to loop the video after playback is complete.

0 (default): The video does not loop.

-1: The video loops indefinitely
parameters.help_zh:
仅对文件视频有效，表示播放完后重复继续播放的次数。 
         
0（默认值）：表示不重复播放。
-1：表示一直循环重复
parameters.name: repeat_num

parameters.help_en: The Presentation Time Stamp (PTS) callback interval. Unit: milliseconds. This parameter is valid only for VOD materials
parameters.help_zh: PTS回调间隔。单位：毫秒，仅对点播素材有效
parameters.name: pts_callback_interval

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image material in the media asset library.

This parameter is required only if the video source is an image
parameters.help_zh:
媒资库图片素材ID。
当视频源类型为图片时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image material.

This parameter is available only if the video source is an image that has not been imported to the material library. The image must be in JPG or PNG format, and its size cannot exceed 10 MB
parameters.help_zh:
图片素材URL。
当视频源类型为图片且图片文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。支持上传jpg、png格式图片，最大文件不可超过10M
parameters.name: image_url

CasterId.description_en: The ID of the production studio. You can use this ID to query video sources, add layouts, or query layout lists for the production studio
CasterId.description_zh: 导播台ID。可作为查询导播台视频源、添加导播台布局、查询导播台布局列表的请求参数
